RP23CNC V2.02 (RP23U5XBB), grblHAL controller board, Brookwood Design (Phil Barrett).
Source: https://github.com/phil-barrett/RP23CNC  ("3D Models/v2.02.zip": STEP exported from KiCad 2026-09-24; drawing from "Documentation/dimensional drawing.png"),
downloaded 2026-11-26. No LICENSE file in that repository: copyright Brookwood Design, kept here for internal CAD use only.
Checked in FreeCAD 26.3: PCB 96 x 96 x 1.6, 4 x D3.2 mounting holes on an 88 x 88 square (4 from each edge, D8 keep-out);
assembly incl. connectors 96.4 x 97.3, z -2.85 (pins under the board) .. +10.85 (above the board top); 357 solids.
Model origin as exported by KiCad (board at x 81..177, y -144..-48): move the board before placing it.
The WIZ850io Ethernet module (plugs onto the WizNet header) is not in this model.
